## Install

1. Download `dammer-<version>.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and choose the unzipped folder.

Works in Chrome 120 or newer and other Chromium browsers (Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera).

See the [changelog](https://github.com/AleenaTahir1/dammer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what is new and the [privacy policy](https://github.com/AleenaTahir1/dammer/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) for what the extension can and cannot see.
